node.title: Mersenne common-factor base-field component descent
node.closure: at least 5079 selected pairs lie on F(X)-defined components
node.statement: In the Mersenne full-gcd branch 2<=d<=43 over F=F_((2^31-1)^4), let P_K be the union of geometric irreducible components individually defined over F(X). Since the characteristic exceeds d, every non-base-field component has a distinct conjugate. A degree-delta component contains at most delta^2 F(X)-rational selected pairs by Bezout with that conjugate. All non-base-field components therefore contain at most d^2 such pairs. Combining this with t_d>=7583-(52-d)^2 leaves at least 5079 selected pairs on P_K, and one base-field absolutely irreducible component carries at least 132. Core incidence forces the received pair onto P_K at at least 126263 inside coordinates, leaving at most 3974 exceptions.
